title: Concordant Region Gatekeeper: latency-aware admission + capacity-constrained failover
creator: Maya Rivera
description:
Goal: Implement a Region Gatekeeper service that enforces latency SLO-aware admission, applies capacity-aware local preference, and executes graceful multi-region failover with circuit-breaker-backed load shedding. The Gatekeeper will be a thin decision layer in front of the existing dispatcher to centralize region selection for incoming requests and to provide a consistent, auditable place for routing policy evolution.

Why this work: Current region selection logic is duplicated across multiple dispatchers and lacks cohesive behavior when regional capacity suddenly degrades. We need a single, testable policy surface that: (1) prioritizes local/low-latency regions under normal loads, (2) transparently degrades to near/remote regions when capacity is constrained while preserving SLO tails, (3) wires into circuit breakers to stop overloading failing regions, and (4) produces signals for observability and automated rollback on quality regressions.

Scope: MVP focuses on read (inference) traffic only, supports JSON policy configs, integrates with existing capacity probes, and exports telemetry for Console (per-region decision metrics, shed counts, fallbacks). Not in scope: per-tenant custom policies, write-heavy stateful routing, or persistent affinity beyond the request KV cache TTL.

Success metrics: 20% reduced cross-region tail latency during steady-state traffic vs current baseline during normal hours (measured P95 for traffic that remains local), 40% fewer emergency cross-region failovers in first-line incidents, and clear per-request reason codes emitted to tracing for 100% of routed requests.
acceptance_criteria: Gatekeeper endpoint deployed behind API gateway and used for >=80% of traffic in the staging region
Policy engine supports: latency-based preference, capacity thresholds, soft geo-favor, and explicit circuit-breaker triggers
When a region reports capacity_burst >= 0.95, Gatekeeper reduces new admissions to that region by at least 50% according to configured shedding curve
Decision traces include reason_code, chosen_region, alternative_regions_tried (ordered), and decision_latency for every routed request
Integrated end-to-end tests that simulate regional capacity loss and validate graceful failover without user-visible errors for 95% of requests (excluding synthetic congestion cases)
technical_notes: Architecture: stateless Gatekeeper service that consults short-lived region state from central region-state cache (1s TTL). Returns decision proto with region, priority_score, and optional override flags to downstream dispatcher.

Policy model: weighted scoring combining latency_hint (historical p50/p95 heatmap), region_proximity (geo pin multiplier), and capacity_penalty (non-linear penalty above 70% load). Configurable weights per env.

Circuit breaker integration: subscribe to region health events from existing CB service. Gatekeeper sets region admission to 0 when CB state is OPEN, and performs exponential backoff probes while OPEN.
Load shedding: two modes — proportional (reduce admission by X%) and categorical (reject all new requests above threshold). Default: proportional until catastrophic thresholds reached.
Observability: emit metrics: gatekeeper.decisions, gatekeeper.shed_count, gatekeeper.fallback_count, gatekeeper.decision_latency_ms. Include tags: region, model_family, route, decision_reason.
Consistency: decisions must be idempotent for retries within the same request TTL. Use request_id input to ensure repeatable choices for duplicates when possible.
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal staging region — Canary 1% traffic for 48h with enhanced logging (03/08–03/10)
Beta: ramp to 25% in staging after fixes (03/11–03/14), validate SLO and fallbacks
Prod Canary: 0.5% traffic in a single non-critical region for 72h, monitor circuit-breaker interaction and shed metrics
Full rollout: progressive 10x ramps with rollback windows based on automated health checks (latency, error-rate, shed_count)
test_plan: Unit tests for policy scoring and capacity penalty functions
Integration tests that stub region-state with failure modes: high-latency, overloaded, circuit-breaker-open
Chaos tests: randomly fail region controllers and validate Gatekeeper falls back to alternatives without exceeding global SLOs
Performance: decision path must add <2ms p95 to request latency under 1000 RPS—benchmarked in k8s perf cluster
E2E: synthetic traffic against canary dispatcher to measure P50/P95/P99 changes pre/post Gatekeeper
risks: Single point of decision: introducing Gatekeeper increases blast radius if there is a bug — mitigate with circuit-breaker in front of Gatekeeper and a transparent bypass toggle in the gateway
Policy misconfiguration could cause steady-state cross-region flapping — implement hysteresis windows and minimum hold times for region decline/restore
Telemetry volume: emitting per-request decision traces could increase observability costs — default to sampled traces and required structured logs for all requests
Interplay with autoscaling: aggressive shedding could starve regional autoscalers of load signals — ensure we emit synthetic load hints to autoscaler when shedding is active
open_questions: Should per-tenant affinity be a v2? (early engineering estimate: +3 points)
What SLA should Gatekeeper itself expose? (propose 99.9% availability for control plane decisions)
How to best represent model-family sensitivity in the scoring (e.g., embeddings vs chat latency tolerance)?
Do we need a persistent audit log for compliance that records every decision long-term? (cost tradeoff)
design_decisions: Keep Gatekeeper stateless and fast; persist region health in a separate cache to avoid coupling
Use a tunable scoring function rather than rigid rule tree to enable easy A/B experiments on weights
Expose decision_reason codes as a stable enum to Console and auditing pipelines
Default to conservative shedding (proportional) to preserve UX while preventing complete region collapse
implementation_todo: Proto: define GatekeeperDecision with fields: chosen_region, alt_regions[], reason_code, trace_id, decision_latency_ms
Service: implement HTTP/GRPC endpoint and a lightweight policy engine with config reload via SSM/ConfigMap
Integrations: subscribe to existing capacity probe topic, circuit-breaker events, and the routing telemetry pipeline
Console: add Gatekeeper dashboard with per-region admission rates, shed counts, and decision latencies
Docs: PRD + runbook for on-call with rollback steps and emergency bypass instructions
